response_body.title: An error occurred
response_body.detail: SQLSTATE[23000]: Integrity constraint violation: 1052 Column 'sku' in WHERE is ambiguous (Connection: mysql, Host: db, Port: 3306, Database: msdss_bagisto, SQL: select count(distinct `products`.`id`) as aggregate from `products` left join `product_attribute_values` as `pav_name_locale` on `products`.`id` = `pav_name_locale`.`product_id` and `pav_name_locale`.`attribute_id` = 2 left join `product_attribute_values` as `pav_name_fallback` on `products`.`id` = `pav_name_fallback`.`product_id` and `pav_name_fallback`.`attribute_id` = 2 and `pav_name_fallback`.`locale` is null and `pav_name_fallback`.`channel` is null left join `product_flat` on `products`.`id` = `product_flat`.`product_id` left join `products` as `variants` on COALESCE(variants.parent_id, variants.id) = `products`.`id` left join `product_attribute_values` as `pav_suggest_product` on `products`.`id` = `pav_suggest_product`.`product_id` and `pav_suggest_product`.`attribute_id` in (select `id` from `attributes` where `code` = suggest) left join `product_attribute_values` as `pav_suggest_variant` on `variants`.`id` = `pav_suggest_variant`.`product_id` and `pav_suggest_variant`.`attribute_id` in (select `id` from `attributes` where `code` = suggest) left join `product_attribute_values` as `pav_brand_product` on `products`.`id` = `pav_brand_product`.`product_id` and `pav_brand_product`.`attribute_id` in (select `id` from `attributes` where `code` = brand) left join `product_attribute_values` as `pav_brand_variant` on `variants`.`id` = `pav_brand_variant`.`product_id` and `pav_brand_variant`.`attribute_id` in (select `id` from `attributes` where `code` = brand) left join `product_attribute_values` as `pav_color_product` on `products`.`id` = `pav_color_product`.`product_id` and `pav_color_product`.`attribute_id` in (select `id` from `attributes` where `code` = color) left join `product_attribute_values` as `pav_color_variant` on `variants`.`id` = `pav_color_variant`.`product_id` and `pav_color_variant`.`attribute_id` in (select `id` from `attributes` where `code` = color) where exists (select * from `product_attribute_values` where `products`.`id` = `product_attribute_values`.`product_id` and `attribute_id` = 8 and `boolean_value` = 1) and exists (select * from `product_attribute_values` where `products`.`id` = `product_attribute_values`.`product_id` and `attribute_id` = 7 and `boolean_value` = 1) and (`sku` like %' AND SLEEP(0)=0 --% or exists (select * from `product_attribute_values` where `products`.`id` = `product_attribute_values`.`product_id` and `attribute_id` = 2 and `text_value` like %' AND SLEEP(0)=0 --%)) and `type` = simple and `product_flat`.`new` = 1 and `product_flat`.`featured` = 1 and exists (select * from `categories` inner join `product_categories` on `categories`.`id` = `product_categories`.`category_id` where `products`.`id` = `product_categories`.`product_id` and `id` = 1) and exists (select * from `product_attribute_values` where `products`.`id` = `product_attribute_values`.`product_id` and `attribute_id` = 11 and `float_value` between 10 and 200) and (((`pav_suggest_product`.`text_value` = 0) and (`pav_brand_product`.`integer_value` = 38) and (`pav_color_product`.`integer_value` = 3)) or ((`pav_suggest_variant`.`text_value` = 0) and (`pav_brand_variant`.`integer_value` = 38) and (`pav_color_variant`.`integer_value` = 3))))
